about: Boss Mod's modules (github.com/awgil/ffxiv_bossmod, BSD-3-Clause, see docs/src/fork/sources.md): battle NPCs (BNpcBase), actions with their casts and shapes (a cone's angle and a rectangle's width are whole widths here), what each is, and the duty. Numbers only: Boss Mod's names for actors, actions and statuses (the game's text) are left out. Made by `questkit sources --build`.
